17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 1903-05 West Huron Street, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: RM-S5 Residential Multi-Unit District

Lot Area: 5,832 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant js proposing to divide the zoning lot so that the new lot at
1903 West Huron Street can be developed with a new three-story two (2)
dwelling unit residential building. The height and footprint of the existing
three-story residential building and coach house at 1905 West Huron Street
will remain without change. The subject property is a Transit Served
Location. The new two (2) unit residential building will be supported by
two (2) garage parking spaces at the rear of the subject property. Pursuant
to Sec, 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation
and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE and 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago
Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street
parking requirement for a Transit Served Location from 50% (one (1)
parking space) to 100% (two (2) parking spaces) and reduce the rear yard
open space to zero for the proposed building at 1903 West Huron Street and
reduce the off-street parking requirement to zero, reduce the total combined
side setback to 2.53 ft., reduce the front setback to 4.82 ft., reduce the rear
setback to zero for the existing building at 1905 West Huron, and is seeking
all relief necessary, as allowed by the code, for the attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio:
a. 1903 West Huron Street: 3,532 square feet (1.23 FAR)
b. 1905 West Huron Street: 5,815 square feet (1.99 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.):
a. 1903 West Huron Street: 1,458 square feet per D.U.
(2 residential units)
b. 1905 West Huron Street: 583 square feet per D.U.
(5 residential units)

(C) *The amount of off-street parking:
a. 1903 West Huron Street: 2 parking spaces
b. 1905 West Huron Street: 0 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Chicago Bus
Route), Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to increase the
off-street parking requirement from 50% (one (1) parking space) to 100% (two (2)
parking spaces) for 1903 West Huron Street and reduce the off-street parking
requirement for 1905 West Huron Street to zero.

@) — Setbacks:
a. 1903 West Huron Street:
i. Front Setback: 14.58 feet (proposed)

a. 1903 West Huron Street: 34 feet-10 inches (proposed)
